blurTest.evidence: At gallery scale, each slide resolves into one blue promise headline, one dominant rendered product state, and one short footer; the product remains the visual center rather than decorative framing.

silhouetteTest.evidence: The phone and tablet groups share the same device-frame language, pale green field, rounded app surfaces, and focused central action or modal silhouette.

fiveSecondTest.evidence: The first slide immediately communicates quick winner selection, followed by pool completeness and the no-account promise without requiring close reading.

realityTest.evidence: All six release screenshots are composed from freshly rendered iPhone and iPad simulator captures using a fictional 16-person roster that accurately matches the free-tier limit.

journeyTest.evidence: The set shows roster entry, a populated pool, classic and wheel modes, a winner state, and the unlimited purchase decision on both phone and tablet.

platformTest.evidence: Source UI was rendered on iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch, then composed into exact 1284x2778 and 2048x2732 App Store canvases with native status bars and safe areas intact.

buyerValueTest.evidence: The screenshots substantiate fast setup, fair repeated picking, up to 16 free contestants, unlimited expansion, restore purchases, and local no-account operation without invented metrics.

implementationTest.evidence: The Release build succeeds, DEBUG-only screenshot fixtures are absent from production behavior, the six staged listing images have valid Apple dimensions, and the screenshot generator is reproducible.

screenFindings: An independent critical pass compared the set with Google Authenticator, TV Remote, 82-0, and Block Blast references: NameSnap adopts single-purpose utility clarity and gameplay-first focus without copying their compositions or importing generic game-store chrome.

The iPhone hero keeps the winner state visually dominant, while the details slide proves roster-scale usefulness and the privacy slide presents the actual purchase surface with visible legal and restore actions.
The iPad layout uses the full tablet width, centers the pool and spin control, and preserves the same task order as iPhone rather than presenting a stretched phone column.

repairs: Replaced the blank iPad privacy source with a deterministic iPad upgrade-state capture and regenerated the final marketing frame.

verdict: Approved for submission. The release screenshot set is accurate, category-fluent, visually coherent across iPhone and iPad, free of celebrity sample data, and complete after replacing the failed iPad privacy capture.
